note.question: How does point redemption affect the seller’s day-to-day pricing and inventory decisions?
note.overview: Reward points function as a new currency that consumers can spend on products and services. This paper studies how point redemption affects the seller’s day-to-day pricing and inventory decisions. Despite widespread use of point redemption, little has been done on its implication on the seller’s operational decisions.
